ok when we have a ticket in review. we need to handle a bit differently, when accepted only the ticket gets accpted not the feature or epic, those need to be accepted individually.

so when a epic has all its tickets complete, then the epic will be showen in the review by itself and require it to be accepted or rejected also.

same with features. so the idea is that we review all tasks untill a features tasks are done then we review the feature and complete that then we review the epic and complete that.

So the way it is now is right, i just want the epics and features to appear for review when their tasks are done

result.title: Layered container review for epics and features
